subject.title: [Feature]:   Add configurable send hotkey for WebChat (Cmd+Enter instead of Enter)

question: Should the WebChat send-shortcut preference live in scoped browser UiSettings, gateway/openclaw.json config, both surfaces, or be declined in favor of current Enter-to-send behavior?
rationale: The issue is a valid UX request, but adding a persisted shortcut preference or gateway config creates product and compatibility surface that repository policy reserves for maintainer direction.

options.title: Use Scoped UiSettings
options.body: Add a default-preserving browser UI preference scoped with existing Control UI settings, route visible copy through i18n, and test Enter, Shift+Enter, IME, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, and persistence.

options.title: Add Gateway Config
options.body: Introduce a documented gateway/openclaw.json setting only if maintainers want operators to control the shortcut across browser clients.

options.title: Keep Current Behavior
options.body: Decline the preference and keep plain Enter as the primary send shortcut, using this issue as the product-decision record for duplicates.

recommendation.title: Use Scoped UiSettings
recommendation.body: Add a default-preserving browser UI preference scoped with existing Control UI settings, route visible copy through i18n, and test Enter, Shift+Enter, IME, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, and persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior ClawSweeper comments and current-main history show the strongest product/settings ownership signal across WebChat, UiSettings, and docs.
